answer: Sybil farms tend to drift together, the way a dune field moves under a single wind. An agent economy can use that: each epoch, it compares how every identity's answers, timing, and attestation choices shift against its own history. Accounts whose changes stay in lockstep are grouped, and their attestations count as one voice until they diverge. A lone juniper on a ridge looks different from a thousand cuttings of one plant, so the bridge to full rewards opens only for identities that move independently.
